$note: Extracted 6 Aug 2026, read directly (pdftotext -layout, poppler). Waterlovers Beach Resort — non-Soroi, Diani Beach. Folder named 'WATERLOVERS' in 2027 tree, which contains SIX files with overlapping/confusing names for what are really only 2 distinct rate cards (base + TO 20%), each duplicated as a full 3-page version and a Breakfast-only-subset 2-page version. MD5 checksums run to confirm: 'NEW 2027 USD Non Resident Rates.pdf' is byte-identical to 'Waterlovers  NEW 2027 USD Non Resident Rates.pdf' (md5 703ed762f8178012717bb7b3fb5f3350), and 'NEW 2027 USD 20% Non Resident  rates .pdf' is byte-identical to 'Waterlovers  NEW 2027 USD 20% Non Resident  rates.pdf' (md5 5fb9ce1093a58214d4dc64fa06e71680) — true exact duplicates, safe to treat as one file each. Separately, 'WATERLOVERS - 2027 USD WL Non Resident Rates.pdf' and 'WATERLOVERS - 2027 USD 20% Non resident rates.pdf' are NOT duplicates of the 'NEW 2027...' files — they are the SAME rate card but with more content: the 'NEW 2027...' pair only shows the Breakfast meal-plan row, while the 'WATERLOVERS - 2027...' pair shows Breakfast + Half Board + Full Board for the same occupancies/prices (Breakfast figures verified identical across both pairs cell-for-cell). Used the fuller 'WATERLOVERS - 2027...' documents as the source of truth below since they are a strict superset of the 'NEW 2027...' documents' data.
